examples.english: This is how unambiguously Albert Rivera, president of Ciudadanos, responded this Sunday to the possibility of supporting the inauguration of the PP leader to the presidency of the Government even if he wins the general elections of 20-D. The emerging formation, to which a Metroscopia poll for EL PAÍS grants 21.5% of the votes, may be the arbiter that decides who arrives at La Moncloa after the elections.
examples.ref: 2015 November 23, “Rivera: “No voy a apoyar a Rajoy” [Rivera: “I won't support Rajoy”]”, in El País:
examples.text: Así de contundentemente ha contestado este domingo Albert Rivera, presidente de Ciudadanos, a la posibilidad de apoyar la investidura del líder del PP a la presidencia del Gobierno aunque este gane las elecciones generales del 20-D. La formación emergente, a la que un sondeo de Metroscopia para EL PAÍS concede un 21,5% de los votos, puede ser el árbitro que decida quién llega a La Moncloa tras los comicios.
examples.translation: This is how unambiguously Albert Rivera, president of Ciudadanos, responded this Sunday to the possibility of supporting the inauguration of the PP leader to the presidency of the Government even if he wins the general elections of 20-D. glosses: decisively, conclusively
